title: Canada map: north stays up on iPhone
kaylee: On an iPhone held upright, Canada now sits the right way round (north up, Pacific on the left) instead of turned on its side.

pictures.title: iPhone, upright
pictures.caption: Turned 15° from the south, a little higher: north up, reads like a toy on a table

pictures.title: iPad, upright (unchanged)
pictures.caption: iPad portrait keeps the sideways view that fills the screen
